tool_input.args: Panels: A(schematic,plot), B(plot), C(plot), D(plot), E(plot), F(micrograph), G(micrograph), H(micrograph), I(plot), J(plot). Figure caption and image as provided. F: fluorescence images of Mitotracker, Paxillin, Merge, 4 conditions, with scale bars mentioned in caption "Scale bars: 10 μm for whole-cell images and 2 μm for magnified images." G,H: similarly "Scale bars: 10 μm for whole-cell images and 2 μm for magnified images." Check image for presence of visible scale bar marks and whether length is on image.

Panels: A(schematic,plot), B(plot), C(plot), D(plot), E(plot), F(micrograph), G(micrograph), H(micrograph), I(plot), J(plot). F contains white boxes around magnified region. G,H contain white boxes around magnified mitochondria region. D has colored tracks (red/orange/green) representing speed categories, defined in caption. Check each panel for annotations and whether caption defines them.

Panels: A(schematic,plot), B(plot), C(plot), D(plot), E(plot), F(micrograph - Mitotracker magenta, Paxillin green, Merge), G(micrograph single channel Paxillin and Mitotracker separately, no merge shown), H(micrograph single channel Paxillin and Mitotracker separately, no merge shown), I(plot), J(plot). Check F for overlay/merge with single channels shown (Mitotracker and Paxillin rows above the Merge row).

Panels: A(schematic,plot - bar-like percentage diagram, not a quantification plot with data points, essentially single values not averages), B(line plot with shaded error, mean of 3 experiments - line plot, individual points not required), C(scatter plot with error bars, each point represents mean of conditions - scatter plot of means with error bars for different exposure times, n small), D(scatter track plots - individual tracks are the data, scatter-like), E(bar chart with individual dots overlaid, migration speed, dots shown), F,G,H(micrographs, not applicable), I(line plot mean+/-sem, line plot, individual points not required), J(line plot mean+/-sem, line plot, individual points not required).

Panels: A(schematic,plot - no error bars, single percentage values), B(line plot with shaded area error bars, caption: "Shaded areas represent mean±s.e.m."), C(scatter with error bars, caption for C: "Data represent the mean±s.e.m. of three independent experiments."), D(track plot, no error bars), E(bar chart with error bars, caption: "Migration speed (mean±s.e.m.)"), F,G,H(micrographs, not applicable), I(line plot with error bars, caption: "Results represent mean±s.e.m."), J(line plot with error bars, same caption as I, shared sentence for I,J: "Results represent mean±s.e.m.").

Panels: A(x-axis categorical exposure time labels with ms units shown as "24 ms" etc, y축 percentage "471%" etc - actually it's more schematic with text labels, not drawn axes - treat as schematic/plot hybrid, check if it has drawn axes), B(axes: y "Normalized Fluorescence Intensity (A.U.)", x "Frame number" - dimensionless count), C(axes: y "ΔROS" no unit shown, x "Exposure time (ms)"), D(axes: y "Y position (μm)", x "X position (μm)" for each of 5 subplots), E(axis: y "Migration speed (μm h-1)", x categorical conditions), F,G,H(micrographs, not applicable), I(axes: y "Normalized area" dimensionless, x "Time (min)"), J(axes: y "Normalized area" dimensionless, x "Time (min)").

Panels: A(schematic-like, check tick sequence if any axis drawn), B(y-axis ticks 0.00, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 1.00, 1.05 - note jump from 0.00 to 0.75, check for break mark - there appears to be a break symbol on y axis based on image), C(axes: y ticks 0,2000,4000,6000,8000 regular; x ticks 0,400,800,1200 regular), D(axes regular -50 to 50), E(y axis 0,10,20,30,40 regular; x categorical), F,G,H(micrographs not applicable), I(y ticks 0.6 to 1.1 regular, x 0-250 regular), J(same as I).

Panels: A(no plot stats), B(asterisks * shown next to legend entries: 0.0245 mW×60000ms green*, 1.34mW* blue, 4.21mW* orange, 31.3mW* red - caption: "P<0.04 from 61.6 mW×24 ms, two-tailed Student's t-test for area under the curve"), C(no significance symbols visible, R^2 shown), D(no stats symbols), E(asterisks * above bars, caption: "*P<0.005 from 61.6 mW×24 ms (two-tailed Student's t-test)"), F,G,H(not plots), I(p=0.002 text on plot, not a symbol), J(p<0.0001 text on plot, not a symbol).

Panels: A(no stat claim), B(claims significance via asterisks and caption P<0.04 two-tailed Student's t-test for AUC), C(no stat claim, just R^2 correlation fit, not significance), D(no stat claim), E(claims significance via asterisks and caption P<0.005 two-tailed Student's t-test), F,G,H(not plots), I(p=0.002 shown, caption: "P-values correspond to Student's t-test for area under the curve" shared with J), J(p<0.0001 shown, same caption statement as I).

Panels: A(single measurement/calculation per exposure time, not replicated data shown, likely schematic demonstration - check if n reported, caption doesn't mention replicates for A), B(caption: "Data represents the average of three independent experiments"), C(caption: "Data represent the mean±s.e.m. of three independent experiments"), D(caption gives n per condition: "n=31 for 61.6 mW×24 ms; n=33 for 31.3 mW×48 ms; n=31 for 4.21 mW×350 ms; n=34 for 1.34 mW×1060 ms; n=31 for 0.0245 mW×60,000 ms" - cells), E(same n values as D, referring to cells, "Number of cells analyzed is indicated in parentheses"), F(representative images, not quantified - check if replicates needed), G,H(representative time-lapse images, not quantified in panel itself, but feed into I,J), I(caption: "n=5 cells from three independent experiments"), J(same n=5 cells from three independent experiments).

Panels and captions as given: A - percentage contribution of IO for different camera exposure times; B - photobleaching decay curves CHO-K1 paxillin-EGFP different light power regiments; C - CellROX photobleaching data points vs exposure time with ΔROS; D - live cell migration tracks 5 conditions with n values; E - migration speed bar chart with n in parentheses; F - Mitotracker/Paxillin/Merge images 4 conditions (control, 0.0245mW, 61.6mW, H2O2); G - time-lapse Paxillin/Mitotracker DLD continuous illumination with time points 0:00-4:00; H - time-lapse Paxillin/Mitotracker CLD interval illumination time points 0:00-2:43; I - cell morphology normalized area over time two conditions; J - mitochondrial morphology normalized area over time two conditions. Compare each panel image to its caption description for consistency.
